verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs describe an API Explorer that makes live API calls in the browser through a guided interface, letting users test endpoints without writing code. It sits alongside a per-resource REST API reference and an llms.txt index of that reference. This covers the core of an interactive reference with runnable calls, but the evidence is first-party only and thin on detail. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable code samples embedded in reference pages, detail on the Explorer's coverage and setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
